lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 91, for issue 89, which keeps folders listed first in name order, A to Z, whatever the sort.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request ninety-one, for issue eighty-nine, which keeps folders listed first in name order, A to Z, whatever the sort.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what this PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
You pick a sort: a column such as Name, Size or Date, ascending or descending.
With Sort folders before files on, a folder still goes before a file, as before.
New: when both rows are folders, Thunar compares their names, A to Z, and ignores the sort.
Two files still follow your column and direction, exactly as before.
The new test makes three folders and three files, then relaunches Thunar with each sort.
It checks every row by copying and pasting it, under six different sorts, one of them in the icon view.
Before, the folder group followed the files' sort, so sorting by Size or Date reshuffled the folders too.
Sorting asks one function which of two rows comes first; for two folders, the answer is now their names.
The icon and compact views sort with one compare function, the detailed view with another.
The check that puts folders before files was already there and is unchanged.
Two folders use Thunar's natural name compare, so dir2 comes before dir10; two folders with the same name fall back to your sort.
lines.say: Two folders use Thunar's natural name compare, so dir two comes before dir ten; two folders with the same name fall back to your sort.

lines.caption: With Sort folders before files off, the new lines never run, so nothing changes.
The test's sizes and dates are chosen so no other column gives the name order.
For each sort it quits Thunar, sets the saved sort column and order, and opens the folder again.
It copies each row, pastes it into a fresh folder, waits for the copy to match, and checks the name.
The fifth sort uses the icon view, and the sixth turns Sort folders before files off; each ends with a screenshot.
By Name, and by Size from largest, the folders read Alpha, dir2, dir10, while the files change order.
lines.say: By Name, and by Size from largest, the folders read Alpha, dir two, dir ten, while the files change order.

lines.caption: By date, and by Name from Z to A, the folders still read A to Z.
In the icon view by Size, the folders still read Alpha, dir2, dir10, then the largest file.
lines.say: In the icon view by Size, the folders still read Alpha, dir two, dir ten, then the largest file.

lines.caption: With folders first off, folders and files mix from Z to A, as before.
The change is these few lines, added to both compare functions so all views agree.
The column header's arrow now describes only the files: by Name descending, folders read A to Z and files Z to A.
Path completion in the location bar lists its folders by name now, too.
To undo it, revert this PR; no setting is stored, and upstream merges meet only a small local change.
The PR changes two source files and adds its test, this page and its narration.
Part 2. How it was built and verified.
It reuses Thunar's name compare and its folders-first check, and follows the issue's test plan.
In this session it built in the cloud container, with one warning that was already there before this change.
After the review fixes, the new test passed in 83 seconds, and all 10 tests passed, the new one included.
lines.say: After the review fixes, the new test passed in eighty-three seconds, and all ten tests passed, the new one included.

lines.caption: The icon view now passes too; the compact view isn't tested, and main can't be shot, as CI installs one build.
CI passed on both pushes, and the audit of all 64 screenshots from the second push passed.
lines.say: CI passed on both pushes, and the audit of all sixty-four screenshots from the second push passed.

lines.caption: A fresh review agent found no correctness problems and raised one risk.
The sort order stays consistent, and path completion now lists folders by name too.
The risk: 30 row checks could near the test's time limit, but the run took 70 seconds, so it stays.
lines.say: The risk: thirty row checks could near the test's time limit, but the run took seventy seconds, so it stays.

lines.caption: CI's own review on the first push found six possible issues, none confirmed.
R1, R3, R4 and R6 are fixed: same-named folders, and three changes to the test.
CI's second review found R7 to R12, all low and unconfirmed; every finding not fixed was accepted.
You accepted R2, R5 and R12: folders stay A to Z under every column, and the copied lines keep upstream merges small.
R7 and R8 describe Thunar's own tie rules for equal names, not a defect.
R9 to R11 are about the test: its name check, its icon row, and its 83 second run, all within limits.
lines.say: R9 to R11 are about the test: its name check, its icon row, and its eighty-three second run, all within limits.

lines.caption: After the merge, sort your own folders in every view; the test uses six names in two views.
The pull request, CI's comments and shots, and the local test output are listed here.
Part 3. Nothing depends on issue 89, so only a look in your own folders remains.
lines.say: Part 3. Nothing depends on issue eighty-nine, so only a look in your own folders remains.

lines.caption: After the merge, sort a busy folder by Size, by Date, and Z to A: the folders should stay A to Z.
In short: folders listed first now always read A to Z, while the files follow your sort.
